seems that there is a breaking change when parsing tags in release 2026.2.26. In the example below the value of `PixelSizeX` changes:

File to reproduce: [TVIPS_bin4.tif](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25584815/TVIPS_bin4.tif)


```python
import tifffile

print("tifffile version:", tifffile.__version__)

tiff = tifffile.TiffFile("TVIPS_bin4.tif")
page = tiff.pages[0]
tags = {tag.name: tag.value for tag in page.tags}
print("PixelSizeX:", tags["TVIPS"]["PixelSizeX"])
```
With tifffile 2026.2.24:
```python
tifffile version: 2026.2.24
PixelSizeX: 1.4208036661148072e-09
```

and with tifffile 2026.2.20:
```python
tifffile version: 2026.2.20
PixelSizeX: 1.4208036661148071
```
